item.title: Major League Baseball proposes delaying salary cap implementation to 2028 in talks with players
item.description: Major League Baseball has proposed delaying the start of a salary cap until 2028. The league says teams have too many commitments for the 2027 season to reduce spending quickly.

item.title: A woman running the NYC marathon for charity dies 2 miles from the finish
item.description: A young Pennsylvania woman running the New York City Marathon for the first time to raise money for Parkinson’s disease research collapsed just over two miles from the finish line and later died.

item.title: Escaped Tennessee inmate convicted of co-worker's murder is recaptured, officials say
item.description: A man convicted of murder who escaped from a Tennessee prison was recaptured on Tuesday after more than a week on the run, authorities said.
